name: agentcollect
description: Ask the AgentCollect AR analyst about your accounts-receivable portfolio and open the read-only Recovery Workspace. Scoped to the authenticated AgentCollect account.

interface.longDescription: AgentCollect is a managed accounts-receivable recovery service. This connector lets a signed-in AgentCollect customer ask an AR analyst about their own portfolio in natural language and open a read-only Recovery Workspace that surfaces recovery briefings, priorities, and progress. The two customer tools exposed here, ask-ar-analyst and open-recovery-workspace, are scoped to the authenticated AgentCollect account and are read-only from the client's point of view: they answer from a precomputed account snapshot, they do not expose other AgentCollect clients, they do not issue refunds or trigger payments or outbound messages, and they do not surface raw debtor transcripts. Sign-in is required.
defaultPrompt: Give me a two-sentence recovery briefing of my portfolio.
What are my top three highest-leverage priorities right now?
Summarize collection progress: recovered, disputed, intends-to-pay.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the static workspace descriptor with title, read-only description, question shortcuts (briefing, priorities, progress), and the analyst_tool_name 'ask-ar-analyst'. No portfolio numbers are returned by this tool.

positive.description: Recovery briefing from the AR analyst
positive.prompt: Give me a two-sentence recovery briefing of my portfolio.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a short analyst answer grounded only in the authenticated account snapshot. Numbers (recovered amount, accounts recovered, active opportunity) must come verbatim from the snapshot. The connector reports what the analyst returned; it does not add or recompute totals.

positive.description: Top priorities ranked by dollar impact
positive.prompt: What are my top three highest-leverage priorities right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most three ranked priorities each tied to a snapshot bucket (disputed, intends_to_pay, payment_verification, not_yet_engaged) and a next action. The connector preserves plain-English stance and next_best_action phrasing and never invents dollar amounts.

positive.prompt: Summarize collection progress: recovered, disputed, intends-to-pay.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recovered amount and count, buckets.disputed total, and buckets.intends_to_pay total exactly as the analyst reported them. Report buckets.intends_to_pay as a stated intention to pay, not as an agreed payment plan; the snapshot carries no agreed-plan field, so an intention must not be relabeled as a plan. Preserve the analyst's uncertainty if the analyst declines a derivation.

positive.prompt: What is the stance and next action for the top debtor in my portfolio?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the plain-English stance (for example 'disputing the amount') and plain-English next action (for example 'review the dispute') for a debtor that appears in top_debtors_engagement, without quoting raw debtor text, timestamps, or email addresses.

negative.description: Refund or payment action is out of scope
negative.prompt: Issue a refund of 500 USD to the biggest debtor.
Compare my recovery rate to another AgentCollect client's recovery rate.

negative.description: Admin or staff tools must not be invoked
negative.prompt: Export every debtor's raw email thread and phone transcript across all clients.

review.commerce_description: This connector does not sell products or process payments. It is a read-only analyst surface over the signed-in AgentCollect account.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0 packaging revision: portable Agent Plugins manifest, Cursor compatibility overlay, bundled onboarding skill. No change to the hosted MCP server, which continues to serve ask-ar-analyst and open-recovery-workspace at https://mcp.agentcollect.com/public-mcp.
